deployment's daily budget and the guests' shared budget apply independently and can still refuse a call while
this allowance is unused. `limit_tokens` (and `remaining_percent`) is null when the personal limit is off =
unlimited; a guest's cap is the smallest enabled of the general user and guest token caps.

get.description:
After the end only: outcome, milestones, the debrief, the final scores, the rule flags and the final dials.
A debrief still pending five minutes after the end lost its finisher (a crash or restart) and is written again
in the background.

post.description: A trainer override of one dial. It never ends the session; the next trainee message decides.
The player stops. The debrief is written in the background; poll GET /debrief.

A preset twist, by whoever may steer: the playtester in their own playtest, or an org admin in a member's
solo session. The outcome is decided on the next trainee message.
An inactivity/silence nudge: when the trainee has been silent, the counterpart prompts them in-character.

get.description: Live progress: 404 for anyone who cannot read the session, 403 for the player of a solo session.

post.description:
The trainer ends a meeting whose time has run out, with or without a result. Only for a scenario whose
`on_timeout` is "trainer", once the server's clock agrees that the time is up.

The clock ran out in the player's browser. If the scenario's rules end the meeting then, and the server's own
clock agrees, it ends now (as a failure or without a result); otherwise this is refused.
One trainee message. The answer is a stream of events: reply chunks, then done (or error).

A free-text twist: the director rewrites it in character, the bias check flags it, and it is applied with the
flag kept. No transaction stays open during the two model calls; they count toward the steering admin's limits.
